Sorry for the slew of newb questions...you guys are great for taking

Shane Siers

messages.author: 527e14923215b7e4
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Deviance and AIC
parts:
Hi Shane,

Follow the example from on the modSel help page and then type: toExport$negLogLike * 2

You can also compute deviance from a fitted model using: -2*logLik(fm)

Richard
